title: Chang'e 4 lands on the far side of the Moon
summary: China's Chang'e 4 probe made the first ever soft landing on the far side of the Moon and released the Yutu-2 rover.
reason: China had a step-by-step lunar program and used a relay satellite to talk to the hidden side.
significance: It showed China's rise as a leading space power.
place: Von Karman crater, far side of the Moon
